column2: Kresh has no abilities, it is a simple tank and spank fight.
Interrupt her "Sleep" ability.
After pulling, immediately kill the three Deviate Pythons before switching to Lord Cobrahn.
Interrupt his "Sleep" ability.
It's located in the Winding Chasm before Lord Pythas.
This is a rare mob that may not be available.
After pulling, CC the Druid of the Fang and kill the other add before switching to Pythas.
Chained Bolt does damage to players near each other so melee DPS should spread out around the boss to avoid damage.
Grasping Vines roots all players within 10 yards, knocks them down and does damage so the healer should try to keep the group's health topped off as much as possible.
Mutanus is spawned during an optional dungeon event that can occur if the four Lords of the Fang bosses have been defeated.
These four bosses include Lady Anacondra, Lord Cobrahn, Lord Pythas and Lord Serpentis.
The event is started by escorting the Disciple of Naralex through the dungeon.
The Disciple of Naralex is found at the start of the dungeon.
Once the Disciple reaches the ritual stone where Naralex sleeps, you will be attacked by waves of enemies.
Mutanus' "Thunderclap" ability does high damage to the tank and any nearby melee DPS so ranged DPS is better for this fight.
He also has two abilities, "Terrify" and "Naralex's Nightmare" that both stun/sleep players so the healer should try to keep the group's health topped off as much as possible.
Before the encounter, you can pull the 2 Defias Watchman without drawing aggro from the boss.
If you cannot do this, use CC on one archer.
If you can't CC, kill the adds before the boss.
Be careful of patrolling elites.
He will be surrounded by Defias Miners that aren't elite.
Try picking them off before engaging Miner Johnson.
Click the line below if the rare spawn isn't available.
Clear the entire room before engaging Sneed's Shredder.
It uses an ability called "Terrify" that will cause you to run in fear.
Once the Shredder is killed, Sneed will hop out and the tank will need to pick it up quickly.
It will disarm the tank so give them time to get aggro.
A Goblin Engineer will pull when you engage him.
CC the engineer, or it will summing a Remote Controlled Golem, which is immune to most abilities.
If the Golem is summoned focus on the engineer.
When you approach the plank, he will automatically engage your group.
There will be two Defias Blackguard that are stealthed.
They need to die before you begin damaging Mr. Smite.
At 66% and 33% he will stun the group for nearly 10 seconds.
At 33% he will gain the ability to stun your tank.
It will be important to keep your tank healed up.
CC adds next to Captain Greenskin before pulling.
Start the encounter by killing the adds, CCing as many as possible.
When you begin the encounter, there will be two Defias Blackguard that break stealth.
CC and kill them before attacking Edwin VanCleef.
At 50% he will summon two more adds.
Repeat the process from before, killing the adds.
Finish the encounter after.
This is a bonus boss, on a little island below.
If you want to be safe, you can clear the adds below before jumping down.
Interrupt "Cookie's Cooking" spell or it heals him.
This is a straight forward encounter, with his only ability being "Soul Drain"
It will immobilize the target and gain health while casting it.
Pulling one of the 3 horses in the stable will pull all 3.
Use CC on at least one of the horses if possible as they deal high damage.
Focus them down one at a time.
Make sure your healer is prepared for the enounter before starting.
Clear the room before starting the encounter.
The fight itself is a simple enough.
Healers will need to watch for the "Veil of Shadow" ability when it is cast.
If you have a hybrid class in your group, support the healer when this ability goes off.
Veil of Shadows will reduce incoming healing by 75%.
This encounter starts with two adds.
Start by focus DPSing the Haunted Servitor.
You can either kill the Wailing Guardsman next, or have a Warlock or Hunter pet Off-tank it.
They have the "Disarm" and "Cleave" abilities, so be sure to keep them away from the group as a tank.
You can use CC or focus DPS them down quickly.
The tank should keep this boss 10 yards away from the group to avoid the AoE Silence it uses.
This boss has a dot ability and is otherwise simple.
In the he room where this encounter takes place, there are 4 adds that should be killed beforehand.
During the fight, he will summon additional Worg that should be killed.
For this encounter, you will want to have ranged DPS and Healers stand at the platform you entered the room in.
As the encounter progresses, Arugal will teleport around the room.
His standard attack, "Shadow Bolt" hits very hard.
There will be Defias enemies surrounding him in the room.
Use CC on the Defias before the encounter.
DPS should focus on the adds before engaging Targorr the Dread.
Finish off the CC'd adds after killing the boss.
DPS should focus on the adds before engaging Kam Deepfury.
There will be two Defias enemies along side Hamhock.
Use CC on them if possible before starting the enounter.
All DPS should focus on killing a single add at a time before switching to Hamhock.
Hamhock will cast "Chain Lightning" which will deal heavy damage to bunched up allies, so spread out as best as possible.
It will be important to keep the tank topped off during this encounter.
His "Smoke Bomb" ability will stun the group for 4 seconds upon use.
Bazil Thredd deals high amounts of single target damage.
His "Intimidating Shout" ability will cause your group to run in fear.
It is important to clear any area around him before engaging.
If you pull extra adds during the fear, be sure to use CC abilities on them as best you can.
DPS should focus down Dextren Ward as soon as possible.
Clear adds before engaging him and kill the boss.
Ghamoo-ra has high armor so melee damage will be significantly reduced.
Spread out as best as possible to avoid taking damage from "Trample".
Lady Sarevess will be patrolling a cave with 2 other Naga.
It's recommended that you kill them before engaging her.
Use CC abilities on her two bodyguards that accompany her.
Kill the adds before starting DPS on her.
Before starting the encounter, clear the room of the Murlocs.
Be careful not to pull them with the boss while clearing them out.
Once the room is clear of adds, kill Gelihast.
Kelris will cast the "Sleep" ability on a random party member.
The healer should keep the tank topped off in case they get slept.
If there is a hybrid class in the group and the healer is slept, you may need to assist.
To unlock the door, click each brazier one at a time and defeat the wave of enemies that spawn from them.
This is an optional encounter.
It takes place underwater.
Keep your eye out for air vents underwater.
Aku'mai deals high damage to a single target during "Frenzied Rage".
This ability lasts for 15 seconds.
High healing will be required for these phases.
This boss spawns from an event started by "Blastmaster Emi Shortfuse".
She will trigger an explosive tha twill cause mobs to spawn from a cave.
Grubbis will eventually spawn.
Before engaging in this encounter, it is recommended that you clear the trash in the room.
After that, the fight itself is simple.
This encounter is standard.
DPS the boss down and move on.
For this encounter, place the groups back against the wall to avoid being knocked off the ledge.
Click the line below to continue.
For this encounter, the DPS in the group should focus down "Walking Bombs" as they close in on the group.
Other than that, kill Thermaplugg in between them.
Clear the area before engaging Roogug.
If you have a warlock in your group, Banish the elemental at his side..
During the encounter, he will summon a boar.
DPS should focus target the boar down then switch back to the boss.
For this encounter, he will be assisted by two caster allies.
It is important to use CC abilities on them before starting the encounter.
DPS should focus down the adds before switching to the boss.
Death Speaker Jargba will use the "Dominate Mind" ability which will Mind Control a party member.
Save all cooldowns for the boss.
Overlord Ramtusk deals high single target damage.
He has two allies that should be CC'd.
CC should be focused on the Spearhides if possible.
Kill Ramtusk then the adds after.
Agathelos the Raging deals massive single target damage.
You might need back up heals if the healer can't keep up.
Have the casters stop casting when Blind Hunter is using it's "Sonic Boom" ability.
Click the line below if the boss isn't there.
Clear the platform before engaging then pull the boss.
Kill the totem he summons as soon as they appear.
If you have a Warlock, you can banish the elemental.
Charlga Razorflank deals high damage.
Pull them down fromt he hut and tank them at the platform below.
The group should spread out if possible.
Interrupt the "Chain Bolt" ability whenever it's being cast.
Clear the area before engaging Interrogator Vishas.
He will use "Immolate" throughout the fight, so be ready for extra healing.
For this encounter, ranged DPS should spread out to avoid taking damage from AoE attacks.
If you see an "Unfettered Spirit", you will be able to spawn this boss.
There are 6 different spawn points across the Graveyard that appear in intervals of 10 to 15 minutes.
Every 10 to 15 minutes, instead of an Unfettered Spirit, Azshir the Sleepless has a chance to spawn.
It will use the "Terrify" ability which will fear the group.
It will also use an ability called "Call of the Grave" which will damage an ally even after the boss is dead.
The Fallen Champion only uses melee abilities, including "Cleave" so spread out when possible.
Ironspine will use the ability "Poison Cloud" so spread out to avoid it.
For this encounter, Loksey will be accompanied by 3 elite Scarlet Tracking Hounds.
They will need to either be CC'd or killed immidiately.
Once the hounds are dealt with, kill Houndmaster Loksey.
For this encounter, he will cast "Detonation" which will damage the entire group.
When he does this, use the pillars to line of sight the ability.
This fight is very healing intensive, so if you have a hybrid class, additional healing may be required.
He will also cast "Silence" on casters.
You will need to collect "The Scarlet Key" from the Scarlet Monastery - Library dungeon to open this.
Additionally, a rogue with leveled "Lockpicking" skill can open the door.
The tank should keep Herod at the center of the room.
He will use the "Whirlwind" ability, he will become immune to magic damage.
Anyone at the center of the room should move from it to avoid getting hit by it, including the tank.
Casters should stay on the ledge above at all times.
When Herod dies, a group of non-elites will rush the room.
Clear the Cathedral before starting this encounter.
He will use the ability "Hammer of Justice" which will stun the target for 3 seconds.
He will use the "Divine Shield" ability, which will make him invulnerable to all damage.
She will primarily cast "Holy Smite", dealing magic damage to the tank.
When she is near death, she will sleep the entire party and revive Mograine.
Both of their health bars will return to full adn the tank will need to pick up Mograine immidiately.
DPS should focus on Whitemane, then Mograine.
He will cast "Curse of Blood" on a party member, which can be dispelled by a mage or a druid.
He will also use "Fear" and "Sleep" on random party members.
Clear the room and ring the gong to begin the encounter.
After each wave, you will need to ring the gong again until the boss appears.
The tank should face the boss away from the group when it spawns.
It's "Web Spray" ability will immobilize any ally in front of it.
Before engaging, clear the enemies around Mordresh.
The last pack of skeletons will draw the aggro of the boss.
This boss is vulnerable to melee damage.
Be sure to interrupt the "Fireball" ability.
Have the tank move out of it's "Disease Cloud" ability.
Heavy heals will be needed when Glutton enrages.
He will use "Dominate Mind" on a random group member, including the tank or healer.
It'll be important to have a back up healer or tank in case this happens.
Interrupt his "Heal" ability when possible.
The tank should tank him facing the tent where he's at.
The group should then stack on top of the tank to reduce damage from "Frost Nova".
He will summon "Frost Spectres".
As soon as one appears, the damage should switch and kill it quickly.
This is an optional fight.
Speak with Belnistrasz to start the event.
Waves of enemies will spawn and may require additional off tanks.
When Belnistrasz is finished channeling, Plaguemaw the Rotting will spawn.
Use Crowd Control abilities on the 2 Stonevault Rockcheres if possible.
If you have no Crowd Control, burn them down before the boss.
Interrupt his "Chain Lightning" ability when possible.
She is immune to Damage Over Time effects.
The tank should face her away from the rest of the group to avoid them being hit with "Arcing Smash".
Range spread out.
This boss is immunity to Damage Over Time abilities.
At 66% and 33% Health, it will spawn two Obsidian Shards.
DPS should switch to killing these before going back to the boss.
This boss has immunity to Damage Over Time abilities.
It also casts the ability "Sand Storms", which will cast Slow and Silence on those caught in it.
He will be accompanied by Shadowforge Geologists.
Heavy AoE damage will be inflicted upon your group.
The Tank should pick up Galgann Firehammer and move him away from the Shadowforge Geologist.
Keep him faced away from the group.
Use Crowd Control abilities on one Shadowforge Geologist, then kill the other.
After, then kill the last Shadowforge Geologist.
Then, switch to Galgann and kill him.
He is accompanied by a Stonevault Geomancer, Stonevault Brawler and a Jadespine Basilisk.
Use a Crowd Control ability on one of the adds.
Then, use all cooldowns and burn down Grimlok as fast as possible.
After, deal with the adds.
He will summon adds through the encounter.
When they appear, all DPS should kill them as soon as possible.
The fight is long, so healers should conserve mana when possible.
During the encounter, he will summon "Sul'lithuz Broodlings" and "Servants of Antu'sul".
When they appear, all DPS should switch to the adds and kill them.
He will summon various totems that should be destroyed as soon as they appear.
This is a mini boss found in the dungeon.
He will cast "Fevered Plague" on group members, dealing damage over time.
When he reaches 30% health, he will become immune to physical and shadow damage.
Zum'rah will cast "Shadow Bolt Volley" which will need to be interrupted.
He will also summon zombies from nearby graves that will attack you.
All DPS should switch to the zombies before moving back to the boss.
Whenever he summons a totem, you should also focus on those.
He will be accompanied by Shadowpriest Sezz'ziz.
Have DPS burn down Nekrum Gutchewer before burning down Sezz'ziz.
Be sure to interrupt Sezz'ziz' "Heal" ability throughout the encounter.
After Nekrum has been defeated, quickly burn down Sezz'ziz.
He will be accompanied by a group of other elites.
DPS should prioritize killing Murta Grimgut and Oro Eyegouge before all else.
Make sure the tank faces the bosses away from the group.
Melee allies should damage him from behind to avoid its "Cleave" ability.
Kill Ruuzlu, then Ukorz.
She patrols around a room filled with elite enemies.
Clear as many as you can without pulling her.
Once you've cleared a safe spot, pull Velratha into the hallway from where you fought Sergeant Bly.
To summon Gahz'rilla, you will need the "Sacred Mallet" that drops from Qiaga the Keeper in the Hinterlands.
You will then need to use the mallet at the altar in Jintha'Alor, also found in the Hinterlands.
Clear the entire room before ringing the gong with the "Mallet of Zul'Farrak".
When engaging, the tank should face him away from the group.
If you don't, the group will be tossed up in the air.
He wanders all over the first half of the dungeon.
Line of sight him into melee range as soon as possible.
Afterwards, the fight is straight forward.
Have the entire group stack on top of each other to avoid the bosses ranged abilities.
He will occasionally use his "Blink" ability, causing him to move away from the group.
Be sure to stack in melee range of the boss as soon as possible whenever this happens.
If you have a Warlock, you can banish the one of the two adds that appear.
Defeat the boss, then finish the adds.
Noxxion will use "Toxic Volley" which will deal damage to the entire group.
During the fight, he will split into tiny versions of himself which need to be killed before you can resume damaging him again.
Razorlash uses the "Cleave" ability, so ranged sould stand at max range to avoid additional damage to the group.
It will also use the "Puncture" ability which will deal heavy damage to its target.
Meshlock patrols the waters near the start.
Ranged should stay spread out and it should be tanked away from the group.
Earth Shock can interrupt spellcasting.
The tank should pick up Corrupt Forces of Nature whenever they spawn.
Focus on killing Celebras first.
Interrupt Wrath whenever possible.
This is a reward from a short quest chain given by Cavindra outside the Foulspore Cavern - Orange dungeon.
The tank should keep him where he spawns.
The tank should also keep their back to the wall when possible.
Ranged stay at a distance.
Ranged will also need to avoid the "Theradrim Shardling" that spawns, which will disappear once the boss dies.
She has the ability "Repulsive Gaze" which will fear the entire group.
Use "Fear Ward" on the tank if possible.
Warriors ability "Berserker Rage" can negate the fear.
Also, use "Tremor Totem" if possible.
Ranged group members should stay at max range to avoid being knocked back by "Dust Field".
Jump down into the water.
Rotgrip deals high damage, so the fight will be very heal intensive.
You may need support heals.
Its ability "Puncture" will deal damage over time increasing this damage.
The tank should face him away from the group to avoid taking damage from "Gobling Dragon Gun".
After, the group should stack in close melee rang to prevent Gizlock from using his "Bomb" and "Shoot" abilities.
Clear the trash in the area as you travel around the platform.
Once cleared, the group will need to spread out and click each Atal'ai Statue in the numbered order indicated on the map.
The Atal'ai Statue will be green if done correctly and Atal'alrion will appear at the center of the room.
He has a threat clearing abilitiy, so it will be important for the tank to keep taunt available.
He will also knock players into the air who will take fall damage after.
Healers should focus on the member who got knocked into the air as soon as they land.
Tanks should keep the boss near a wall and be prepared to kite if the group healer gets knocked into the air.
There will be 6 sub bosses you need to kill.
To start, clear the Pit of Refuse of all mobs.
You'll run up the stairs and reach an area similar to the Atal'ai Statue area for the previous boss.
Instead of activating the Atal'ai Statues, there will be the bosses Loro, Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Zul'lor and Hukku.
After defeating the Atal'ai Defenders, the way to Jammal'an will open up.
Clear the trash in the Lair of the Chosen, watching out for Atal'ai Deathwalkers "Fear" abilitiy.
Ghosts will spawn when some of the enemies die here, all of which you can do is kite run away from them.
Engage once all enemies are clear.
Separate Jammal'an and Ogum when the fight starts, killing Ogom as soon as possible.
Then, spread out as best you can.
Jammal'an will use the "Hex of Jammal'an" ability, transforming a party member into a hostil Berserker.
Switch damage to the "Hex of Jammal'an" then burn down the boss as quick as possible.
The tank should keep their back to the wall and keep all drakes facing away from the party.
All of their abilities hit in front of it, so this will save you needless healing.
Similar to the last encounter, the tank should keep their back to the wall and keep all drakes facing away from the party.
Clear all dragon enemies before pulling this boss or they will swarm you.
All ranged should stay at max distance to avoid being stunned by its "War Stomp" ability.
The abilities "Fade" for Priest, "Blessing of Salvation" for Paladin and "Feint" for Rogues should be used to mitigate threat when possible.
The target with the highest threat will be the target of Eranikus' "Deep Slumber" ability, which will make you unable to act for 15 seconds.
Melee never stand in front of this boss.
This is a long fight so side heals might be necessary.
Clear trash in the Sanctum of the Fallen God.
This boss can only be summoned by using the "Egg of Hakkar" which is for the quest "The God Hakkar".
Players whom have completed the quest can use "Yeh'kinya's Scroll" to summon as well.
Once used, kill adds that spawn.
Eventually, a Hakkari Bloodkeeper spawns.
Collect the "Hakkari Blood" from their corpse and extinguish the Braziers in the room.
Repeat the process until all are extinguished.
The Avatar of Hakkar will use "Cause Insanity" on random players.
CC or Stun the player if possible until it wears off.
He will also use "Shadow Word: Pain" which should be dispelled when possible.
Her most dangerous ability is "Psychic Scream" which will fear the entire group, possibly leading to adds being pulled.
Fear Ward and "Tremor Totem" will come in very handy during this encounter.
Fight her in a corner of the room to try and control where your party runs during fear.
Dispel her "Shadow Word: Pain" when applicable.
Interrupt her "Mana Burn" when possible also.
The "Prison Cell Key" is important to loot from her before moving on.
This boss can use "Earth Shock" which will interrupt any casters spells and prevent casting for 2 seconds.
It also casts "Flame Shock" which will leave a dot on a party member.
Before engaging him, pull and kill the two packs of hounds patrolling the room with him.
Range should keep their distance to avoid being interrupted with "Pummel".
Other than that, this is a pretty straight forward encounter.
There are multiple bosses that can appear in this event.
Gorosh the Dervish: Spread out to avoid "Whirlwind" damage and try to heal outside of "Mortal Strike".
Grizzle: Range should stay at max distance to avoid "Earth Shock".
Eviscerator: If applicable, have a priest use "Shadow Protection".
Ok'Thor the Breaker: He will use "Polymorph" on a random player in the group, which will need to be dispelled asap.
Anub'Shiah: Dispel it's "Curse of Tongues" and "Enveloping Web" abilities immidiately.
Hedrum the Creeper: Dispel the it's "Paralyzing Poison" and "Baneful Poison" when possible.
Clear all enemies along the path he patrols before engaging.
This boss hits very hard, so extra healing may be required.
Be sure to interrupt his "Holy Light" as to not prolong the encounter.
Ranged should keep their distance as he will interrupt you otherwise.
The most important thing for this encounter is to not get knocked off the platform.
Avoid its "Mighty Blow" ability to ensure that.
This is an optional boss and may be skipped.
Destroy his totems when they are summoned.
He will spawn adds which need to be killed quickly.
The tank will need to face him away from the group to prevent damage from "Magma Splash".
This boss is optional.
During the encounter, he will summon adds which need to be AoE'd down.
Aside from the tanks picking up adds, the fight is straight forward.
Have the group spread out as far as possible.
Purchase 6 Dark Iron Ale Mugs from Plugger and give them to Private Rocknot.
This will enrage him and cause Phalanx to burst through the door.
The group should spread out as far as possible to avoid "Thunderclap".
Heavy AoE healing will be needed for the encounter.
During the encounter, adds will spawn.
They will need to be killed before reaching Flamelash.
Casters need to watch out for its "Spell Reflection" ability.
They will spawn and come at you one at a time.
Each possesses a couple of weakened abilities from a class.
Interrupt whenever possible and burn them down quickly.
To open the door, kill Shadowforge Flame Keepers and collect two Shadowforge Torches.
Use them to light the braziers that open the door to Magmus.
For this encounter, the tank will need to position Magmus properly.
If this doesn't happen, the group will take heavy damage from the flame vents in the room.
During the encounter, your group will need to decide what to do with Princess Moira Bronzebeard.
Keep her CC'd if you chose to save her while keeping her away from AoE damage.
If you fail to keep her controlled, have a group member dedicated to interrupting her healing abilities.
Kill adds then focus on the boss.
This requires the Skeleton Key from the quest "The Key to Scholomance".
She has 3 abilities to look out for:
Curse of Impotence reduces magic damage output on the target and can be removed by a Mage or Druid.
Curse of Weakness reduces the melee damage output on the target and can be removed by a Mage or Druid.
Paralyzing Poison should be removed by a Druid, Shaman or Paladin if possible.
This boss is summoned by "Blood of Innocents", obtained from Blood Steward of Kirtonos, Doctor Theolen Krastinov and Jandice Barov.
Use it on the porch to summon Kirtonos.
The tank should keep their back to the wall to prevent knockback.
While in human form, he will use various curses that can be dispelled by Mages and Druids.
Once he transforms into a Gargoyle, the fight becomes very straight forward.
She will use the ability "Curse of Blood" which should be dispelled by Mages and Druids.
She will also summon Illusions of herself, which will need to be killed.
They cannot be AoE'd so you will need to single target damage all of them.
Carefully clear the area around Rattlegore before engaging.
He hits hard, so this fight will be healing intensive.
The tank should face him away from the group.
The Viewing Room Key comes from this encounter, which lets you progress further into the dungeon.
The tank should keep Marduk stationary when possible.
Range should stand far enough back to avoid being hit by Defiling Aura.
When he casts "Shadow Shield", melee will take extra damage each time they hit.
Avoid standing in his "Flamestrikes" radius when cast.
Clear the area around him before engaging.
If possible, interrupt his "Fear" ability, as well as his "Frostbolt Volley".
For this encounter, it is important to interrupt her "Heal" ability.
Druids and Mages should keep an eye out for "Call of the Grave" which sould be dispelled as soon as possible.
The tank should pull Theolen and keep their back to the wall.
The tank should also save defensive abilities for when the boss reaches 50% health.
He will gain 50% increased attack speed at that point, making the fight healing intensive.
He should be tanked at the lower level of the room, while all ranged stay at the top level and DPS/Heal from the balcony.
Anyone afflicted by "Volatile Infection" needs to move away from the rest of the party.
The tank should stand with their back to a wall, facing Ravenian away from the group.
Melee watch out for its "Cleave" and "Sundering Cleave" ability.
He is accompanied by two skeleton body guards which can be CC'd with either a Priests "Shackle Undead" or a Paladins "Turn Undead".
In the room, there is green liquid on the ground which the group must stay out of.
The tank must bull Alexei to max range from range so they don't take damage from "Unholy Aura".
Mages and Druids must dispel "Veil of Shadow" when a party member is afflicted with it.
She used the "Dominate Mind" ability on random party members.
Use CC abilities on them when it happens.
Clear the entire room to avoid pulling adds from her "Fear" ability.
She also uses the "Silence" ability, which will disable nearby casters from using spells.
The tank should keep him where he spawns if possible, while ranged stay stay at the top of the stairs.
During the encounter, he will teleport a random player to one of the rooms where previous bosses were.
That player will be locked in until the kill all enemies inside.
This includes the tank!
If the tank is teleported, you will need to kit the boss around the room until they are out.
Interrupt "Arcane Missile" on rotation.
Mages and Druids should dispel "Improved Shadow Bolt" as soon as possible.
It's a small wooden box on the ground.
Spread out as best you can to avoid being hit by "Flame Breath".
He will use "Smoke Bomb" which will stun anybody caught by it.
There are two spots he can spawn; Just before Fras Siabi and on the east portion of the map.
Interrup its spells when possible.
He can spawn after the rat gate.
Spread out a little to avoid being hit with "Multi-Shot".
He will randomly cast "Enchanting Lullaby" on a random player.
This boss spawns as you walk through the gate at the opposite end to where Timmy the Cruel is.
Be sure your health and mana are healed up before passing through the gate.
He will have non elite adds along with him.
To summon this boss, kill "Stratholme Couriers" found throughout the instance.
Collect the "Market Row Postbox Keys".
Next, find and open 3 of the locked Mailboxes.
Each mailbox will spawn a group of hard-hitting elites.
Let the tank open them if possible.
On the 3rd, Malown will spawn close to where Fras Siabi was.
If you haven't already, clear the area to avoid pulling adds during "Fear".
Mages and Druids should dispel "Curse of Tongues" when possible.
He will heal while using "Ravenous Claw", but other than that the fight is straight forward.
During the fight, he will use the "Lay on Hands" ability which will heal him significantly.
The chest behind him contains the "Medallion of Faith" for the quest The Medallion of Faith.
They are on the floor near boxes in the room.
This mob can be skipped if no one in the group needs the "Bottom Half of Advanced Armorsmithing: Volume II" for Blacksmithing.
He has no special abilities to account for.
His ability "Burning Winds" is a high damage DoT that will make this fight healing intensive.
If the tank is hit with the ability, the Galford may swap targets.
